About Nandhini Anand Jeyahar

Interdisciplinary background spanning computer vision, cognitive science, and systems facilitation.

My journey started with a fascination for genetic algorithms and machine vision. Over two decades, it has evolved into a deep practice of systems thinking, data engineering, and group dynamics.

I work with teams who want to make better decisions. Sometimes that means writing optimized C++ scene detection code, sometimes it means auditing dataset leakage, and sometimes it means facilitating applied theater circles.
